messages:
nina: quick async: summarizing follow-ups from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. want concrete owners, short validation steps, and one measurable canary plan.

omar: i reproduced the leak pattern on a prod-replay. hotspot looks like the indexer.writeBatch path retaining lots of small buffers. uploaded heap diffs: https://redwood/s/INC-2133/heapdiffs.tar.gz

jess: curious if fragmentation is driven by slab allocation or by many short-lived slices. my local runs show heap_frag_percent rising steadily under burst load.

nina: OK compact plan below — please ack and take ownership. we'll keep SRE gate tight.

nina: ACTIONS (minimal / measurable):
- 1) Deep profiling (owner: omar) — run cpu + alloc pprof on staging replay, attach flamegraphs to INC-2133, mark top 3 callpaths. due: 2026-03-29
- 2) GOGC/runtime GC probe (owner: jess) — run GOGC=150 and a SetGCPercent(200) experiment; report heaplive, pauses, and p99 latency. create PR with runtime flags. due: 2026-03-30
- 3) Soft admission + metrics (owner: pat) — implement `kv.soft_limit_pct` and metric `kv_soft_rejects_total`; add prom alert for `rate(kv_soft_rejects_total[5m])>10`. due: 2026-03-31
- 4) Small-object compactor (owner: omar) — opt-in compactor task targeting tiny objects every 3h; expose `kv_compact_runs`. due: 2026-04-02
- 5) Canary plan + SRE gates (owner: nina) — canary 2% -> 10% w/ rollback if `error_rate > 0.6%` or `heap_frag_percent > 0.78`. due: 2026-03-29
- 6) Retro + recurring pattern ticket (owner: nina) — create INF-3600 weekly follow-up. due: 2026-04-05

omar: profiling snippet i used:```GOGC=100 ./server --replay=prod-short
pprof -svg server.alloc > /tmp/alloc.svg
```

jess: for GC probe i'll use runtime/debug.SetGCPercent in a feature-flagged path so we can toggle without rolling code. will include pause graphs.

pat: soft limit config draft:```kv.cache.max_entries=48M
kv.soft_limit_pct=82
kv.soft_reject_mode=tail_eviction
``` PR will include README for oncall validation.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-softcap by @pat at 1866100200  route 2% | sha: d4f6a2b

jess: SRE note: please include p50/p95/p99 latency and CPU oversubscription in the canary dashboard. SRE will block expansion if p99 latency +70ms or error_rate > 0.5%.

omar: uploaded flamegraphs: https://redwood/s/INC-2133/flames.zip  initial observation: large retention from `indexer.append` where a bytes.Buffer grows and is not reset. propose object pooling + reuse.

pat: PR opened: https://redwood/pull/INF-3591-PR1 (soft cap + metrics + README). will start canary now.

infra-bot: alert: heap_frag_percent exceeded 0.80 on prod-4 at 1866100288  SRE paging threshold.

nina: noted. halting canary expansion. SRE, please validate if this is correlated or noise.

jess: i'm pausing the GC probe changes until we have a stable baseline — will post comparisons once stable.

pat: rolling canary to 0% until SRE gives thumbs up.

infra-bot: deploy updated: canary-kv-softcap route 0% at 1866100305 by @pat

nina: i'll update INC-2133 timeline and create INF-3600. scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow for telemetry review. if anyone reassigns action items, ping me. thanks all.

omar: taking compactor and profiling tasks. will iterate on pooling patch.

jess: will run GC probe and share numbers.

pat: will track PR validation steps and add expected dashboards for oncall.

nina: closing this async thread. follow-up meeting info added to INF-3600. thanks everyone.
